ownership_summary: The Knicks (New York Knicks, LLC) are wholly owned by Madison Square Garden Sports Corp. (NYSE: MSGS), which is controlled by the Dolan family: as of 30 June 2026 the Dolan Family Group owned all Class B stock and about 3.0% of Class A, about 70.8% of voting power. MSGS's board approved spinning off the Rangers, expected 26 October 2026; MSG Sports is then renamed and trades as the Knicks company under MSGK, with James Dolan as chairman and CEO. Forbes records the purchase as 1997 for $300M (Cablevision era).
